## HyoukaUI 0.1.2

Same addon content as 0.1.1, republished so that the release archive checksum is stable. The 0.1.1 archive was uploaded twice and its checksum no longer matched the first upload; 0.1.1 should not be used.

The release archive is now built reproducibly and a published archive is never replaced.

**What 0.1.1 contained**
- Run totals panel: skull, coin and chest icons; damage rows refresh at most once a second; guardian respawn text no longer blinks.
- Build list: cooldown column shows the cooldown time (`1.5s`, `30s`, `2m`) instead of a running timer; the list and the jewelry rows are wider (225 px).
- Damage meter: ranks of one ability merged into one row; ability icons no longer disappear; retail class colors (shaman is blue).
- English mode has no Russian text left.
- Nameplates: fixed a crash that switched the module off.
- Clean installs start with the author's preset (`/hui preset default` applies it again).
